name: postgres-dev
description: Local PostgreSQL development environment via Docker, with healthcheck

just.snippet:
POSTGRES_CONTAINER := "jtr-postgres-dev"
POSTGRES_USER := env_var_or_default("POSTGRES_USER", "postgres")
POSTGRES_PASSWORD := env_var_or_default("POSTGRES_PASSWORD", "postgres")
POSTGRES_DB := env_var_or_default("POSTGRES_DB", "app_dev")
POSTGRES_PORT := env_var_or_default("POSTGRES_PORT", "5432")

# Start a local Postgres container and wait until ready.
postgres-up:
    @docker rm -f {{POSTGRES_CONTAINER}} 2>/dev/null || true
    docker run --rm -d \
      --name {{POSTGRES_CONTAINER}} \
      -p {{POSTGRES_PORT}}:5432 \
      -e POSTGRES_USER={{POSTGRES_USER}} \
      -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD={{POSTGRES_PASSWORD}} \
      -e POSTGRES_DB={{POSTGRES_DB}} \
      postgres:16-alpine
    @echo "waiting for postgres..."
    @for i in $(seq 1 30); do \
        docker exec {{POSTGRES_CONTAINER}} pg_isready -U {{POSTGRES_USER}} >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; \
        sleep 1; \
    done; \
    echo "postgres did not become ready"; exit 1
    @echo "postgres ready on postgresql://{{POSTGRES_USER}}:{{POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@localhost:{{POSTGRES_PORT}}/{{POSTGRES_DB}}"

# Stop the local Postgres container.
postgres-down:
    -docker stop {{POSTGRES_CONTAINER}}

# Open a psql shell against the local Postgres container.
postgres-psql:
    docker exec -it {{POSTGRES_CONTAINER}} psql -U {{POSTGRES_USER}} {{POSTGRES_DB}}

task.snippet:
postgres-up:
  desc: Start a local Postgres container and wait until ready
  cmds:
    - docker rm -f jtr-postgres-dev 2>/dev/null || true
    - docker run --rm -d --name jtr-postgres-dev -p "${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}:5432" -e POSTGRES_USER="${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres}" -e POSTGRES_DB="${POSTGRES_DB:-app_dev}" postgres:16-alpine
    - echo "waiting for postgres..."
    - for i in $(seq 1 30); do docker exec jtr-postgres-dev pg_isready -U "${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}" >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done
    - docker exec jtr-postgres-dev pg_isready -U "${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo "postgres did not become ready" >&2; exit 1)
    - echo "postgres ready on postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}@localhost:${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}/${POSTGRES_DB:-app_dev}"
postgres-down:
  desc: Stop the local Postgres container
  cmds:
    - docker stop jtr-postgres-dev || true
postgres-psql:
  desc: Open a psql shell against the local Postgres container
  cmds:
    - docker exec -it jtr-postgres-dev psql -U "${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}" "${POSTGRES_DB:-app_dev}"
